name: LinuxForHealth/hl7v2-fhir-converter
what_it_is: A Java library that converts HL7v2 messages to FHIR R4 bundle resources using declarative YAML templates. Uses HAPI HL7v2 for parsing and HAPI FHIR for modeling.
components: YAML message templates per message type
YAML resource templates per FHIR resource
protocols: HL7v2 (ADT, DFT, MDM, OMP, ORM, ORU, PPR, RDE, VXU, OML)
constraints: DFT_P03 does not convert FT1 segment
No REST or messaging interface; library only
Debug logs stripped at build to prevent PHI leakage
notable_absences: No REST API or HTTP server
